lib.enrichFileWriteSubtitle: Optional gate for writing metadata directly to your audio files on disk
lib.enrichWriteToFileDesc: Off: results are stored only in Shiranami's database. Your audio files on disk stay untouched.
lib.enrichWriteToFileDestructive: On: embeds metadata directly into your audio files on disk (MP3, FLAC, M4A). This cannot be undone.
lib.enrichConfirmWriteBody: About to write tags to up to {{count}} audio file(s). This modifies the files on disk and cannot be undone.

app.title: Appearance

app.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the app
app.sidebarDesc: Choose which items appear in the sidebar
app.nowPlayingViewDesc: Double-click album art in the player bar or now-playing card, or press Ctrl+Shift+P, to open an immersive full view
app.libraryHeroCardDesc: Show the large now-playing card above Library and Favorites. Turn off to give albums more room — the player bar still shows track info.

dl.title: Downloads
dl.subtitle: yt-dlp integration for searching and downloading music
dl.installOnePassTitle: Install missing tools in one pass
dl.installOnePassDesc: Shiranami will download yt-dlp and ffmpeg, then unpack everything it needs automatically.
dl.ytdlpLatest: yt-dlp is already on the latest release.
dl.ytdlpInstallHint: Install missing tools above to add yt-dlp.
dl.ffmpegLatest: ffmpeg is already on the latest release.
dl.ffmpegInstallHint: Install missing tools above to add ffmpeg automatically.
dl.ffmpegRecommendedNote: ffmpeg enables MP3 conversion and thumbnail embedding for downloads. Without it, audio downloads as webm or opus.
dl.locationHint: Search downloads are saved here automatically.

upd.title: Updates
upd.macNotice: Auto-updates are not available on macOS because the app is unsigned. Download new versions manually from GitHub Releases.
